summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of the CipherBox project, implementing IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust and TypeScript layers with TDD and security threat modeling.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves, 0 blockers in verification) and execution reached 3/4 plans complete (58-01 through 58-03) with 58-04 still in progress when the transcript ends.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core — cross-vector tests must live in crates/fuse/tests/ to avoid dependency cycles
Phase 58 uses worktree isolation on branch feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage with executor model 'sonnet' and parallelization enabled per roadmap config
The local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was confirmed running at execution time, enabling the 58-02 full-SDK-E2E gate
Phase 58 locked decisions D-01..D-13 span CBOR binding, non-CAS embedded-sequence enforcement, web/sdk-core resolve dedup, and cross-language verify vectors
TDD mode and fine granularity were set on this phase in ROADMAP.md
AUTO_MODE (--auto flag) auto-handles checkpoints including the human-checkpoint in 58-02

code.finding: New resolve_ipns_verified wrapper added here as the chokepoint routing all 9 FUSE resolve sites through signature verification
ciborium dependency was confirmed present here after a stale diagnostic claimed it was missing mid-execution
expectedSequenceNumber guard at this line is the CAS 409 conflict check — intentionally kept, not part of D-09 non-CAS sequence enforcement

workflow: Sequential executor mode was chosen over parallel worktree mode for a crypto security phase to avoid cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees
API socket errors mid-executor cause completion signals to be lost but commits still land — always assess git state before deciding on recovery vs respawn
An executor given a specific plan (58-02) can bleed into the next plan (58-03) in the same run; verify git log to identify what actually executed
SDK E2E gate can silently skip if the API on :3000 is compiled from dist with a mismatched TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, returning 401 on test-login — treat 'infra-limited' skip as a deferred gate, not a pass
The commit_failed signal from the commit helper is a known false negative — verify via git log rather than retrying
RESEARCH.md open questions lacking (RESOLVED) markers trigger cosmetic checker warnings; fix in-place rather than re-running the planner

friction: 58-01 executor hit an API socket error (connection closed) mid-task-4, losing the completion signal and requiring a continuation subagent
